name: greeting_prefix
label: Greeting
help_text: Word before the referee's first name, e.g. "Hi" → "Hi Jane,".

name: firstname_fallback
label: First Name Fallback
help_text: Shown when the referred contact has no first name on file.

name: referrer_fallback
label: Referrer Name Fallback
help_text: Used in place of {referrer} when the referrer_name property is empty.

name: intro_line
label: Intro Line
help_text: Opening sentence. Use {referrer} where the referrer's name should appear — it's filled from the referrer_name property (falls back to the value above).
default: {referrer} has decided to pass on the benefits and wants to share VIPSCLUB with you.

name: recommended_label
label: Recommended Service Label
help_text: Small heading above the recommended service. Only shown when a service was referred.

name: message_label
label: Message Label
help_text: Small heading above the referrer's message. Only shown when a message was included.

name: invite_line
label: Invitation Line
help_text: Sentence above the button prompting them to sign up.
default: Use the invitation below to create your account and learn more.

name: button_text
label: Button Text
help_text: Call-to-action button label. Leave empty to hide the button.

name: button_url
label: Button Link
help_text: Where the referee goes to create their account — usually the create-account page.

name: points_line
label: Sign-up Points Line
help_text: Line about the points they get on joining. Edit the number here.
default: When you join using this invitation, you will receive 250 points to get started.

name: disclaimer_text
label: Disclaimer
help_text: Small print explaining why they received the email. {referrer} is replaced with the referrer's name.
default: This invitation was sent because {referrer} provided your details through the VIPSCLUB referral program. If you were not expecting this email, you may disregard it.

name: team_name
label: Team Name
help_text: Sender name shown under the sign-off.

name: accent_color
label: Accent Color
help_text: Brand colour for the service link, message bar, and button. Defaults to VIPSCLUB red.
